cause_quote: The new partial plugin reload only adds a channel to channelTargets when `previousRegistry.commands.some((entry) => !nextRegistry.commands.includes(entry))` or `changedPluginIds.has(channel.pluginId)`, so retained command entries leave native-command channels running on candidates from the retired registry.
user_saw: After any plugin config hot reload, every plugin slash command on Telegram (and Discord/Slack native commands) replied that the command was no longer available after the plugin registry changed, until the Gateway restarted.
summary: Plugin reload now also restarts channels with native commands that had plugin commands for that channel in the replaced registry, so they rebuild command candidates bound to the new registry.
reasoning: Before b5134de70af8 the plugins.* hot-reload path called `beforeReplace(beforeChannelIds)` with every attached channel, stopping and restarting them all, while the retired-registry refusal and Telegram's start-time `listNativeCandidates` capture already existed, so candidates were refreshed. #145484 replaced that with targeted restarts that retain unchanged plugin records and command entries by identity, and the collectTargets logic the fix extends was introduced there verbatim. Medium because I did not run the pre-#145484 path to confirm a plugins.entries change reached the full-restart branch end to end.
